title: Novel method for producing plasticised PLA films: method, materials, and characterization
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,11594-11602
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07926H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Gerardo Coppola, Sebastiano Candamano, Catia Algieri, Corradino Sposato, Chiara Morano, Leonardo Pagnotta, Mariano Davoli, Stefano Curcio, Sudip Chakraborty
A novel green solvent-based method for plasticized PLA-based dense films for food and medical applications is presented. The casting method and the plasticizer content gives tunable enhanced interfacial, morphological and mechanical features.
